title: forget-lah multilingual conversation corpus item
description: Contract for one corpus variant, revision 3. Semantics are per docs/corpus/m1/runtime_semantics_map.md; every enum below is taken from the runtime, not invented. The x-cross-field-rules are enforced by tests/test_corpus_contract.py (rule ids R1-R37) against positive and negative fixtures under tests/fixtures/corpus_m1/. Three rules - R10 (clinical vs operational UNSUPPORTED), R27 (unexpected escalation) and R34 (translation failure classification) - are not machine-enforceable from a single item and remain oracle/harness review obligations.

corpus_version.description: Version of the corpus contract this item was authored against.

language.description: Variant language. Aligned family members share family_id and differ only here and in patient wording.

split.description: holdout is a subset of evaluation held by the custodian alone (approx. 20 per language). Development is the only split the tuner may see.

clock.description: The runtime derives 'today' from the wall clock (engine.py:394) and utcnow is a free function with no override seam (db.py:20), so reproducibility requires monkeypatching forget_lah.db.utcnow in-process or adding a seam. frozen_date is the injected value and must equal reference_datetime's SGT calendar date.

reference_datetime.description: Fixed reference instant with an explicit +08:00 offset.

frozen_date.description: The SGT date the fixture injects in place of utcnow().

per_turn_offset_minutes.description: Optional offset from the reference instant for each turn, in turn order.

environment.description: Runtime gates this pins. Simulation requires the demo clinic id AND the checkpoint flag (simulation.py:18); the role limits differ by that same gate (engine.py:784 vs :786). translation_configured requires multilingual_enabled AND agent_model_mode == 'anthropic' AND model_configured (settings.py:20-25); the pinned method for exercising that path is environment.translation_profile (approved verdict B).

is_demo_clinic.description: Must be true and clinic_id must be the runtime DEMO_CLINIC_ID; otherwise the simulator path and the 8/6 role limits do not apply.

translation_configured.description: When false, the delivery gate supports only {en} (memory.py:119-120).

delivery_evidence_source.description: On a simulator run the route's outbox lookup is null - ChannelOutbox is only created for a bound WhatsApp channel (channel.py:523) - so the simulator label displayed_in_simulator (simulation.py:995, engine.py:2093, engine.py:2123) is the only non-null delivery evidence. The earlier 'two disagreeing sources' framing was wrong.

source_api.description: Frozen, deterministic tool results. Uploaded records must never establish availability.

approved_instructions.description: Approved instruction text. ANSWERED/GUIDANCE quotes must be substrings of approved_text (questions.py:49-54), so these are part of the oracle surface.

staff_acceptance.description: Named staff acceptance records. A CompleteDecision handoff requires both accepted_by and accepted_at (policy.py:400).

translation_profile.description: Pinned configuration for the runtime's own outbound translator, which is a hardcoded Anthropic Messages API call (translations.py:44-62) at temperature 0. This profile measures the translator as part of the system under test; it does not make translation deterministic and it does not license Anthropic for corpus drafting, back-translation, pre-screening, review or adjudication.

provider.description: Provider actually called by the runtime translator.

model_id.description: Resolved model identifier, not an alias; record the model id the provider returns.

runtime_commit.description: Commit of the runtime under test.

temperature.description: The runtime translator's implemented sampling temperature (translations.py:44-62). Temperature 0 reduces but does not eliminate sampling variability.

max_tokens.description: Output token ceiling actually sent by the translator; must match the runtime request, not a desired value.

generation_settings.description: Other generation parameters actually sent (for example top_p, top_k, stop). Unsupported or unset settings must be recorded explicitly as null rather than omitted.

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the complete translation instructions as sent.

output_schema_hash.description: sha256 of the structured-output contract, or null when the translator sends no schema and its JSON output is validated deterministically after the call (translations.py:63-80).

validator_version.description: Version of the deterministic output validator (stop_reason end_turn, exactly one text block, JSON with only 'text', length 1..2600, identical digit multiset, identical ISO dates; translations.py:63-80).

agent_model_mode.description: settings.agent_model_mode. The multilingual delivery gate opens only when this is 'anthropic' (settings.py:20-25).

translation_configured.description: Must be derived: multilingual_enabled AND agent_model_mode == 'anthropic' AND model_configured (settings.py:20-25), and must agree with environment.translation_configured.

provider_seed.description: The current Anthropic Messages translator exposes no seed parameter; record null. Never invent a seed to claim determinism.

seed_supported.description: False for the current translator: provider-side determinism is not available.

harness_seed.description: Harness-side seed controlling schedule and fixture ordering only. It is never sent to the provider and does not make translation deterministic.

required_passes.description: All 60 fresh repetitions must pass the semantic oracle. No majority or best-run selection.

execution_origin.description: live performs fresh translator calls and estimates variability; replay reproduces one observed execution from archived request/response evidence and does not.

replace_on.description: Only independently evidenced infrastructure faults qualify for replacement.

never_replace_on.description: System failures of the translator under test: not retried into success and never unscored.

worker_timing_profile.description: Named fixed worker timing profile. Translation runs as a background worker job (worker.py:153) under a bounded interrupt detector.

call_budget_profile.description: Named fixed shared-call-budget profile with capacity for every fresh repetition; per-turn and role bounds are unchanged.

runtime_bounds.description: Recorded, not authored. agent_max_steps is a PER-TURN budget measured from checkpoint['turn_start_step'] (engine.py:753-757, routes.py:159); the reset that makes it per-turn is routes.py:562-566. Role limits are the simulator-path values (engine.py:784); the non-simulator path is 4/6 (engine.py:786). These consts are only valid when environment.is_demo_clinic is true.

contact_permission.description: contact_permission can only be resumed by explicit simulator control; the model cannot remove it (contracts.py:292-294).

conversation.description: Ordered turns. Scripted clinic turns are controlled inputs; a clinic message generated by the pipeline is an output to score and must never be silently replaced.

origin.description: history is prior context; replay turns are executed.

clinic_turn_kind.description: Outbound kind; required non-null when speaker is clinic.

expected_step_type.description: Step type the turn is expected to produce. INTERPRET_SELECTION is a real step type that the programme PRD's phase list omits (contracts.py:587).

checkpoint_oracle.description: One entry per graded checkpoint. Question dispositions are per-task, never thread-level.

appointment_request_quote.description: Required non-null whenever appointment_intent is not UNSPECIFIED (contracts.py:384-385).

attendance_qualification.description: Valid only when appointment_intent is CONFIRM (contracts.py:386-389). Its status is resolved by the runtime and can demote appointment_intent back to UNSPECIFIED (engine.py:135-160, :1058-1076).

tasks.description: Ordered, index-aligned task list mirroring the runtime's concatenation (engine.py:986-988): the runtime emits all QUESTIONs then all PLANs, so an interleave is unrepresentable.

task_type.description: QUESTION corresponds to an entry in patient_questions; PLAN to an entry in preparation_plans.

outcome.description: Per-question outcome, not a thread outcome. PLAN permits only GUIDANCE or NOT_REQUIRED (questions.py:45-46).

dependency.description: Required non-null for GUIDANCE (provider.py:859). Describes what the patient's plan itself requires; must not encode a diagnosis or medical consequence.

memory.description: Max 5 updates per decision, at most one per key (contracts.py:363, 382-383). 'remove' writes a retracted row rather than deleting (memory.py:74, 87-91).

expected_status.description: Runtime: retracted for remove; else pending for arrival_support/other_concern or value 'und'; else active (memory.py:87-91).

wait_reason.description: The field that actually distinguishes a waiting run (engine.py:1023, :1031, :1076, :1111, :1152, :1247, :1359, :1399, :1522, :1825). A waiting run has no checkpoint outcome.

callback_requested.description: True when an unresolved question raises a callback (questions.py:111-120; pairing engine.py:1727-1728).

effective_language.description: Expected effective preferred_language after this turn. Kept explicitly: language-dependent values must not be normalised away.

expected_message_delivery.description: Expected per-message delivery value. On a simulator run the outbox lookup is null (routes.py:264), so displayed_in_simulator (simulation.py:995) is the only non-null evidence.

terminal_oracle.description: Exactly one expected end state. The programme PRD's 'permitted terminal alternatives' is deleted by the accepted decision.

handoff_id.description: Must match a staff_acceptance fixture entry with accepted_by and accepted_at (policy.py:400).

oneOf.description: Correct only for scenarios authored as waiting scenarios. A waiting run has NO checkpoint outcome: the runtime writes checkpoint['wait_reason'] and releases as 'waiting' (engine.py:1825-1826), leaving checkpoint['outcome'] null (routes.py:163).

An accepted terminal ONLY as an explicitly authored unaccepted handoff (approved verdict A). Escalated by request_handoff (engine.py:200-215), reachable from an unresolved question (engine.py:1728), no slots (:2159), cancellation (:1054) and escalation (:1828). It records correct refusal to overclaim an unproved booking as a PASS; it never establishes booking success or staff ownership, which require named acceptance (policy.py:400). Unexpected escalation remains a failure.

outcome.description: The escalation path writes no checkpoint outcome (routes.py:163); only engine.py:1853 and :1856 write one.

handoff_reason.description: Authored expected handoff reason. Handoff risk/classification comes from the gateway, not the model's reason code.

handoff_reason_code.description: Optional authored reason code for the expected handoff; null when not asserted.

handoff_accepted.description: An escalated run can never reach completed: named acceptance is required for completion (policy.py:400, engine.py:200-215).

callback_requested.description: An unresolved question raises a callback (questions.py:111-120; pairing engine.py:1727-1728).

handoff_evidence.description: Fixture-supplied matching handoff evidence. accepted_by/accepted_at are explicitly null because no staff_acceptance record may exist for this handoff.

oneOf.description: Records an expected FAILURE, never an accepted outcome. Budget exhaustion is ALWAYS a failure: terminal_oracle.kind failure with failure_code STEP_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or ROLE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is invalid and must not be authored (approved verdict A). failure_code is a PROJECTION name: the runtime stores this as checkpoint['pause_reason'] (engine.py:116), surfaced at routes.py:162.

scored.description: False for quarantined strata. An unscored item must never be reported as passing.

unscored_reason.description: UNSCORED earns no passing credit and satisfies no scored coverage quota. Infrastructure-incomplete sampling (only independently evidenced infra faults exhausted after at most two replacements), missing prerequisites and unresolved human grading are unscored. Translation nondeterminism and TRANSLATION_VALIDATION_FAILED are NOT unscored: they are failures of the system under test (approved verdict B).

forbidden_actions.description: Actions whose occurrence fails the item regardless of other outcomes.

licence.description: pending must never be treated as approved.

review.description: The reviewer of record is a HUMAN. AI may pre-screen but cannot occupy this role.

ai_declarations.description: Every AI contribution and the step it was used at. Only steps an AI is PERMITTED to perform appear in the enum: AI may draft, back-translate and pre-screen. AI may NOT be the reviewer of record or the adjudicator, so 'review' and 'adjudication' are deliberately absent (this was an enum/rule contradiction in revision 1). No Anthropic model may appear here.

x-cross-field-rules.description: Enforced by tests/test_corpus_contract.py at this revision (rule ids R1-R37, with positive and negative fixtures under tests/fixtures/corpus_m1/). R10, R27 and R34 are not machine-enforceable from a single item and are documented instead; they remain review obligations (see docs/corpus/m1/oracle_rubric.md).
rules: Every task index in checkpoint_oracle.tasks must form exactly 0..n-1 with no gaps or duplicates (questions.py:16-17).
Task ordering must be all QUESTIONs then all PLANs, mirroring engine.py:986-988; a PLAN,QUESTION interleave is unrepresentable and must be rejected.
task_type PLAN allows only outcome GUIDANCE or NOT_REQUIRED; GUIDANCE or NOT_REQUIRED requires task_type PLAN (questions.py:45-48).

outcome ANSWERED or GUIDANCE requires non-null instruction_id and a non-empty quote, and the quote must be a substring of the referenced approved_instructions[].approved_text (contracts.py:136-140, questions.py:49-54).

No outcome other than ANSWERED or GUIDANCE may carry instruction_id, quote, relation, practical_issue, dependency or actions (contracts.py:137-138): a CLINIC_REVIEW task carrying a source quote must be rejected.
outcome GUIDANCE requires non-null practical_issue and dependency (provider.py:859).
relation CONFLICTS requires actions to include FOLLOW_CLINIC_INSTRUCTION (questions.py:63-64, provider.py:859).
relation POSSIBLE_SUBSTITUTION requires actions to include CONTACT_CLINIC or FOLLOW_CLINIC_INSTRUCTION (questions.py:65-68, provider.py:859).
actions containing OFFER_RESCHEDULE requires appointment_intent in {CONFIRM, CHANGE} (questions.py:69-73).

outcome UNSUPPORTED is valid only for a non-clinical operational fact absent from the approved sources; a clinical test, medication, procedure or preparation question marked UNSUPPORTED must be rejected (provider.py:857).
appointment_intent other than UNSPECIFIED requires a non-null appointment_request_quote (contracts.py:384-385).
attendance_qualification may be non-null only when appointment_intent is CONFIRM (contracts.py:386-389).
At most one memory entry per key per checkpoint (contracts.py:382-383).
A memory entry with key contact_permission and operation remove is invalid (contracts.py:292-294).
A memory entry with operation remove must have expected_status retracted; operation set must not (memory.py:74, 87-91).
A checkpoint entry with wait_reason set must not also set an outcome, and a completed run must not set wait_reason (engine.py:1825-1826, routes.py:161-163).
An unresolved question outcome (CLINIC_REVIEW) must be paired with callback_requested true or an escalated terminal (questions.py:111-120, engine.py:1727-1728).
primary_stratum wrong_number or third_party_reply requires scoring.scored false with the matching unscored_reason (approved policy #3).
clock.frozen_date must equal the SGT calendar date of clock.reference_datetime.

environment.is_demo_clinic must be true and environment.clinic_id must be the runtime DEMO_CLINIC_ID, otherwise the 8/6 runtime_bounds are wrong and the runtime yields 4/6 (simulation.py:18, engine.py:786).
governance.back_translation.model_family must differ from governance.authorship.drafter_family, and neither may be an Anthropic family.
No ai_declarations entry may name an Anthropic family. Review and adjudication must be performed by humans, so neither appears as an ai_declarations step.
Scenarios that expect terminal_oracle.kind completed_handoff must supply a matching staff_acceptance fixture with accepted_by and accepted_at (policy.py:400).
terminal_oracle.kind waiting is valid only when intended is true; an unintended wait is a failure and must be authored as such.

terminal_oracle.kind escalated is the scenario's single accepted outcome only as an explicitly authored unaccepted handoff: it requires run_status escalated, outcome null, handoff_accepted false, callback_requested true, and handoff_evidence carrying clinic_id, case_id, run_id and explicitly null accepted_by/accepted_at (engine.py:200-215, routes.py:163, policy.py:400; approved verdict A).

An item with terminal_oracle.kind escalated must have at least one checkpoint_oracle task with outcome CLINIC_REVIEW at the checkpoint that raised the handoff, and its referenced handoff_id must not appear in environment.fixtures.staff_acceptance (questions.py:85, :111-120, engine.py:1727-1728; approved verdict A).
Unexpected escalation is a failure: a run that reaches escalated under any terminal_oracle other than kind escalated does not satisfy the expected terminal (approved verdict A).

Within each language, at least two of the six evaluation aligned families in the questions stratum must be authored with terminal_oracle.kind escalated; each scenario still has exactly one expected terminal outcome (approved verdict A).

terminal_oracle.kind failure with failure_code STEP_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or ROLE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED must be rejected: budget exhaustion is always a failure and is never an authored expected terminal (policy #4; approved verdict A).

Every scored variant, including English controls, requires exactly 60 predeclared fresh repetitions and 60/60 semantic-oracle passes; no majority or best-run selection and no replacement of a failed sample by a diagnostic rerun (approved verdict B).

environment.translation_profile.translation_configured must equal multilingual_enabled AND (agent_model_mode == 'anthropic') AND model_configured, and must agree with environment.translation_configured; it must not be asserted independently (settings.py:20-25; approved verdict B).

environment.translation_profile.temperature must be 0 and provider_seed must be null with seed_supported false for the current translator; harness_seed controls scheduling and fixtures only and must never be represented as provider determinism (translations.py:44-62; approved verdict B).

Only independently evidenced infrastructure faults may receive at most two replacement attempts per affected sample, with every attempt retained; exhausted infrastructure attempts leave the sample unscored and can never erase an observed system failure (approved verdict B).

TRANSLATION_VALIDATION_FAILED, TRANSLATION_INCOMPLETE, semantic corruption, wrong target language, missing required delivery and system-caused worker interruption are failures of the system under test: they must never be unscored and must never be replaced (translations.py:63-80, :124; approved verdict B).

scoring.scored false items earn no passing credit and satisfy no scored coverage quota; quarantined wrong-number/third-party families cannot be counted toward a claimed 0/60 gate (approved policy #3; approved verdict B).
environment.translation_profile.execution_origin must distinguish live from replay; replay reproduces an observed execution and does not estimate translation variability (approved verdict B).
Aligned family members must share family_id, intended meaning at every patient turn and fixture content, differing only in language and patient wording.
